new_deps.name: @oh-my-pi/chord
new_deps.why: protocol.ts:1 imports `type JsonValue` and codec.ts:1 imports `isJsonValue` from chord. That is the ENTIRE coupling — 2 symbols, 2 import lines. new_deps.name: typebox@1.3.27

new_deps.name: @oh-my-pi/omptype
